purpose: Allow Codex and MCP clients to inspect deriv_ea report artifacts without changing runtime state.

tools.name: deriv_ea.list_reports
tools.description: List available report artifacts under the configured reports root.

tools.name: deriv_ea.read_repo_capabilities
tools.description: Read repo capability report artifacts for safe planning.

tools.name: deriv_ea.read_demo_status
tools.description: Read demo readiness and dry-run status artifacts.

tools.name: deriv_ea.read_shadow_status
tools.description: Read shadow status, dashboard, and blocker artifacts.

tools.name: deriv_ea.read_symbol_policy
tools.description: Read symbol inclusion and blocked symbol policy artifacts.

tools.name: deriv_ea.read_replay_metrics
tools.description: Read replay metric and diagnostic report artifacts.

tools.name: deriv_ea.read_agent_loop_state
tools.description: Read canonical agent loop state report artifacts.

tools.name: deriv_ea.read_bot_factory_loop_status
tools.description: Read bot-factory loop dry-run status artifacts.

tools.name: deriv_ea.read_shadow_quality
tools.description: Read shadow decision quality report artifacts.

tools.name: deriv_ea.propose_task_queue
tools.description: Propose a safe draft task queue artifact from report evidence.

tools.name: deriv_ea.propose_experiment_queue
tools.description: Propose research experiment queue artifacts from hypothesis and proposal reports.

tools.name: deriv_ea.propose_safe_pr_plan
tools.description: Propose safe draft PR plan artifacts from experiment proposal reports.

tools.name: deriv_ea.propose_pr_plan
tools.description: Propose a draft PR plan artifact from safe task and review reports.

notes: Clients using this contract must fail closed when a requested report is missing.
The propose tools return text or artifact proposals only and must not mutate repos, launch processes, call terminals, write databases, or create merge actions.
Any future implementation must resolve report paths to absolute paths and clamp them beneath the configured reports root before reading.
